heroEyebrow: One page a day · Daily journal
heroLead: In a little room by the window, talk or jot down what happened today. Backgrounds, stickers and a note from Mochi & Dubu decorate the page for you.
soonNote: Coming soon to iPhone and Android. We're doing our final testing now.
chip3: Your diary stays on your phone
altRoom: Jieun sitting by a sunset window — the first screen of FeelDiary
howTitle: The app decorates. You just tell your story.
howLead: If decorating felt like work and keeping a diary was hard to stick with, it only takes three steps.
altVoice: Tapping the mic and talking about today
s1t: Talk or type a few lines
s1p: Pick your mood and the weather, tap the big mic and talk like you would to a friend. It turns into text on your device. Add up to 3 photos.
s2p: A background, photo spots and handwriting that suit your mood and the weather, plus a note from Mochi & Dubu.
altBrag: A brag card with the text blurred
s3p: Pages stack up in your diary. Share a brag card or save a PDF — text on brag cards is blurred by default.
winEyebrow: A place to rest your day
winTitle: Open the app to a little room by the window
winLead: A quiet moment to catch your breath before you write. The room is ready to listen to your day.
w1t: Light for the time of day
w1p: Clear sunshine in the morning, a sunset glow in the evening, moonlight at night.
w2p: Soft piano, music-box tunes and quiet nature sounds keep you company. One tap turns all sound off.
w3p: Choose who sits by the window with you — Jieun or Doyun.
altDay: A diary page decorated with three photos and a winter background
pageCap: A page made with FeelDiary (a made-up entry for the demo)
pageTitle: A page that fits who you were today
p1p: Cherry blossoms, cloud walks, morning sun… the paper is chosen to suit the day.
p2p: The background drifts softly, and petals, leaves or snow float by.
p3p: They read your day and leave one line of empathy — gentle on the hard days.
p4p: Change the layout to fit your words and photos, and pick a title font — or upload your own.
mochiLine: “You made it through today. Lighter tomorrow ♡”
bookTitle: A diary that becomes more yours every day
b1: Choose one of 6 covers and give your diary a name.
b2: Every day you write shows on the calendar and the cover, and your streak shows how many days in a row.
b3: Flip through pages and pinch to zoom. A monthly page gathers the whole month.
b4: Fill in a missed day, or edit an entry and the page is decorated again.
b5: Save or send today, this month or the whole diary as a PDF.
ptT: Points for every day you write
ptP: Write on the day to earn points, then open new backgrounds in the Background Shop. On your 7th, 30th and 100th day, you pick a background to keep.
altBook: Diary calendar with a stamp on each day written
safeTitle: Because a diary is just for you
safeLead: FeelDiary never sends your diary anywhere — not even to us.
c1p: Your voice becomes text right on the device. Recordings are never uploaded.
c2p: No ads, no analytics, and no server that reads your diary.
c3t: Back up to your own cloud
c3p: Google Drive on Android, iCloud on iPhone — restore on a new phone.
c4p: If you like, polish an entry with your own ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini. Everything works without it.
proTitle: Plenty for free. Pro is a one-time purchase.
proLead: Not a subscription. Buy once and keep it on every device with the same store account.
f1: Write by voice or by typing
f5: The window room and its music
f6: 3 backgrounds, plus more you open with points
f7: Moving decorations that suit each background
proTag: Buy once · make it even prettier
r1: Every background, picked to suit the day
r4: Remove the app name from brag cards
priceNote: Prices vary slightly by country in each store.
q1: Does it work without the internet?
a1: Yes. Dictation, decorating, your diary and PDF all work on the device. Only backup and AI polishing need the internet.
a2: Type instead — the page is decorated just the same. A line or two is enough.
q3: What happens when I change phones?
a3: Back up to Google Drive or iCloud from Settings, then use 'Restore from backup' on the new phone.
q4: Do I have to buy Pro again on a new phone?
a4: No. With the same store account, tap 'Restore purchase' on the Pro screen. (Purchases don't move between the App Store and Google Play.)
a5: 18 languages, including English, Korean and Japanese. Mochi & Dubu's notes are written in each language's own voice.
q6: Where do I send questions or report a problem?
a6: Email us at ksr6960@daum.net. Tell us your phone model and what you were doing, and we can look into it faster.
